acceptanceCriteria: A reseal after merging origin/main reuses the prior citation plan without citation-plan-map-mismatch, shown by a test.
body: Seen on #1064 (twice) and other lanes: after merging origin/main, the merged sealed CEM file appears as a hunk and a reused citation plan fails citation-plan-map-mismatch. Expected: merged seal files from main are excluded or auto-cited.

holds.reason: Owner decision: dogfood reseal-after-merge is a design question for the owner.

title: Dogfood: a merged-in seal file adds a CEM hunk, so every reseal after merging origin/main needs a rewritten citation plan
